p.i: & prodigiis sæpius illustrauerat, ipsi vbique altaribus eversis effodiunt, flammis absumunt, in profluentem abiiciunt: Vt ista, inquam, omnia praetermittam, & solum de contumeliis verborum loquar: Quid, quaso, Erasmus Roterodamus? An non Luciani im-[illegible, ~10 letters] supergravit ? Ille enim Deos falsos, vereque ridiculos irrisit: At[illegible, ~6 letters]nus veros Angelorum cives, verique Dei amicos & domesticos, ut Apostolus loquitur, contumeliosissi-me tractavit.

main_text.head: Rainoldus.
main_text.p: Cum ambitiosus ille adolescens, cui unus orbis non suffecit, Plutarch.in vita Demosth.{a}ab Athenien-sibus deposcere per legatos, vt oratores eorum Demosthenem, Charidemum, & alios, sibi dederent; Demosthenes, in populi concionem prodiens, Maxim.Pla-nud.in Æsopi vita.{b}Æsopi fabulam recitauit: lupos, quo tempore animalia inter se colloquebantur, bellum ovibus intulisse: quibus quum venirent canes auxilio & arcerent lupos, eos legato ad oves misso po-stulasse, ut, si in pace vivere: neque ullum bellum suspicari vellent, canes sibi dederent; oves autem, quum ob stultitiam persuasae hoc fecissent, praesidio canum orbatas, a lupis interemtas esse. Pontifex Romanus bonum nostrum expetens, ut Alexander Athenien-sium, & pacem absque omni suspicione belli nobilcum inire cupiens, per Bellarminum nos sollicitat, ut Erasmum, Lutherum, Magdeburgenses, Calvinum, aliosque omnes reli-gio-

page.notes: The initial woodcut letter is not clearly legible; the printed word after it reads "um", so it is taken as C ("Cum"), but this is uncertain. The overprinted line with "Luciani im-pium longo intervallo" is partly illegible because of the overlapping text. The line "At ... nus veros" is also partly illegible. The superscript marks a and b are shown as {a} and {b}. Faint show-through of a heading "Bellarminus" near the top of the page was ignored.
